SELECT id, user_id, name, phone, birth_date, gender, trainer_requested, joined_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM members WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO members ( user_id, name, phone, birth_date, gender, trainer_requested, joined_at, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{trainerRequested}, #{joinedAt}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE members SET name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, gender = #{gender}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{memberId}
UPDATE users SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ( SELECT user_id FROM members WHERE id = #{memberId} )

UPDATE members SET name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, gender = #{gender}, trainer_requested = #{trainerRequested}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql:
FROM members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id
LEFT JOIN user_local_credentials lc ON lc.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN member_memberships mm ON mm.id = ( SELECT mm2.id FROM member_memberships mm2 WHERE mm2.member_id = m.id AND mm2.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm2.start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND mm2.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY mm2.end_date ASC, mm2.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
LEFT JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id
LEFT JOIN trainer_assignments ta ON ta.id = ( SELECT ta2.id FROM trainer_assignments ta2 WHERE ta2.member_id = m.id AND ta2.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ta2.started_at DESC, ta2.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
LEFT JOIN trainers t ON t.id = ta.trainer_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT member_id, MAX(checked_in_at) AS last_attendance_at FROM attendances GROUP BY member_id ) latest_attendance ON latest_attendance.member_id = m.id
AND ( m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.keyword}, '%') OR m.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.keyword}, '%') OR lc.login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.keyword}, '%') )
AND m.status = #{condition.status}
AND mm.id IS NOT NULL
AND mm.id IS NOT NULL AND mm.end_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
AND mm.id IS NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT m.id, m.name, lc.login_id, m.phone, m.status, mp.name AS membership_name, DATEDIFF(mm.end_date, CURRENT_DATE) AS remaining_days, t.name AS trainer_name, latest_attendance.last_attendance_at
ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT #{page.size} OFFSET #{page.offset}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUSPENDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS suspended_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS withdrawn_count FROM members

SELECT m.id, m.name, lc.login_id, m.phone, m.birth_date, m.gender, m.joined_at, m.status, u.last_login_at FROM members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN user_local_credentials lc ON lc.user_id = u.id WHERE m.id = #{memberId}

SELECT mm.id AS membership_id, mp.name AS membership_name, mm.start_date, mm.end_date, GREATEST(DATEDIFF(mm.end_date, CURRENT_DATE), 0) AS remaining_days, LEAST( 100, GREATEST( 0, ROUND( DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, mm.start_date) / GREATEST(DATEDIFF(mm.end_date, mm.start_date), 1) * 100 ) ) ) AS usage_percent, mm.status FROM member_memberships mm JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id WHERE mm.member_id = #{memberId} AND mm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm.start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND mm.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY mm.end_date ASC, mm.id DESC LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO members ( user_id, name, phone, birth_date, gender, trainer_requested, joined_at, status ) VALUES( #{userId}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{trainerRequested}, CURRENT_DATE, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS member_id, m.name AS member_name, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workout_sessions ws WHERE ws.member_id = m.id AND YEARWEEK(ws.started_at, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURRENT_DATE, 1) ) AS weekly_workout_count, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.attendance_date) FROM attendances a WHERE a.member_id = m.id AND a.attendance_date >= DATE_FORMAT(#{centerToday}, '%Y-%m-01') AND a.attendance_date < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(#{centerToday}, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ) AS monthly_attendance_count, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.attendance_date) FROM attendances a WHERE a.member_id = m.id AND a.attendance_date >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(#{centerToday}, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND a.attendance_date < DATE_FORMAT(#{centerToday}, '%Y-%m-01') ) AS previous_month_attendance_count, ( SELECT mp.name FROM member_memberships mm JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id WHERE mm.member_id = m.id AND mm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm.start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND mm.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY CASE mp.product_type WHEN 'GYM' THEN 0 WHEN 'COMBINED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, mm.end_date ASC, mm.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS membership_name, ( SELECT mm.end_date FROM member_memberships mm JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id WHERE mm.member_id = m.id AND mm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm.start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND mm.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY CASE mp.product_type WHEN 'GYM' THEN 0 WHEN 'COMBINED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, mm.end_date ASC, mm.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS membership_end_date, ( SELECT DATEDIFF(mm.end_date, CURRENT_DATE) FROM member_memberships mm JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id WHERE mm.member_id = m.id AND mm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm.start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND mm.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY CASE mp.product_type WHEN 'GYM' THEN 0 WHEN 'COMBINED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, mm.end_date ASC, mm.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS remaining_days, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(mm.remaining_pt_sessions) FROM member_memberships mm JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id WHERE mm.member_id = m.id AND mm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm.start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND mm.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND mp.product_type IN ('PT', 'COMBINED') ), 0) AS remaining_pt_sessions FROM members m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT a.checked_in_at FROM attendances a JOIN members m ON m.id = a.member_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND a.checked_out_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.checked_in_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id AS trainer_id, t.name AS trainer_name, t.specialty FROM members m JOIN trainer_assignments ta ON ta.member_id = m.id AND ta.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN trainers t ON t.id = ta.trainer_id AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ta.started_at DESC, ta.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT wr.id AS routine_id, wr.title, wr.description FROM members m JOIN workout_routines wr ON wr.member_id = m.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND wr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND wr.start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (wr.end_date IS NULL OR wr.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY wr.start_date DESC, wr.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT re.exercise_name, re.target_sets, re.target_reps_min, re.target_reps_max, re.target_weight FROM routine_exercises re WHERE re.routine_id = #{routineId} AND (re.day_of_week IS NULL OR re.day_of_week = WEEKDAY(CURRENT_DATE) + 1) ORDER BY re.display_order ASC, re.id ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT ws.id AS session_id, COALESCE(wr.title, '개인 운동') AS routine_title, ws.started_at, ws.ended_at, COUNT(DISTINCT wset.exercise_name) AS exercise_count FROM members m JOIN workout_sessions ws ON ws.member_id = m.id LEFT JOIN workout_routines wr ON wr.id = ws.routine_id LEFT JOIN workout_sets wset ON wset.session_id = ws.id AND wset.completed = TRUE WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY ws.id, wr.title, ws.started_at, ws.ended_at ORDER BY ws.started_at DESC LIMIT 3
